2034-2092-8167.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
2034-2092-8167.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can forego sacrificing the Dragon tokens. You could also do this combo with Agatha having power 6, but you won't get infinite creature tokens or colorless mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7509-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
6972-7509-8095.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
1833-6495-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3678-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3678-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

877-2921-3184-4645.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

3257-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

647-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
647-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
647-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4559-5330-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
4559-5330-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5330-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-2034-7200.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

149-664-2757--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Frilled Deathspitter.
Frilled Deathspitter triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-664-2757--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

5078-5231-6918-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

5670-6094-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6094-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

1129-1781-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1781-1978.description:
Cause Harabaz Druid to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

1492-2854-4574-6766.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2854-4574-6766.description:
Cast Welding Jar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

215-3390-3518-5921-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-3390-3518-5921-6865.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can continue the combo returning any noncreature, nonland permanents with mana value 5 or less. You should instead cast Astelli Reclaimer for its normal mana cost in this case.

147-3645-6798.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3582-3987-6798.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

You control at least four untapped creatures, two of which must be red and the other two must be red and/or green.

Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R} and tapping two red creatures you control, causing it to be copied due to its conspire ability, creating at least 20 Treasure tokens.
Activate sixteen Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}{R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}
Cast Revel of the Fallen God by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G} and tapping two red and/or green creatures you control, causing it to be copied due to its conspire ability, creating eight 2/2 Satyr creature tokens with haste.
Cast Regrowth by paying {1}{G} and tapping two Satyrs, causing it to be copied due to its conspire ability, returning Brass's Bounty and Bala-Ged Recovery from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R} and tapping two Satyrs, causing it to be copied due to its conspire ability, creating at least 20 Treasure tokens.
Activate nineteen Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {12}{R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Bala-Ged Recovery by paying {2}{G} and tapping two Satyrs, causing it to be copied due to its conspire ability, returning Regrowth and Revel of the Fallen God from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

261-338-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-338-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-856-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1409-2972-4875-6348.easyPrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with Sarkhan.
"Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
1409-2972-4875-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it, Ganax and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, choosing Ganax and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

64-372-673.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-673.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2976-3478-4019-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Dimir Aqueduct.
Dimir Aqueduct does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Dimir Aqueduct.
2976-3478-4019-5227.description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing DImir Aqueduct to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding one mana of the chosen color.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Repeat.

2232-2608-2905-3084.notablePrerequisites: Aether Vial has exactly three charge counters on it.
2232-2608-2905-3084.description:
Activate Aether Vial by tapping it, putting Pestermite onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Aether Vial.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Derevi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Aether Vial by tapping it, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Aether Vial.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Pestermite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2713-3458-4050-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {R/G}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Impromptu Raid by paying {R/G}, revealing Golgari Thug from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2757-4350-5189.description:
Activate a basic land, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Butcher Ghoul.
Butcher Ghoul's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghave's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control besides Butcher Ghoul.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Butcher Ghoul, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Butcher Ghoul, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling creature token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.
